content: How to model the interactions among the input text is the most important problem in reading comprehension. In AutoJudge, we employ a pair-wise attentive reader to process INLINEFORM0 and INLINEFORM1 respectively. More specifically, we propose to use pair-wise mutual attention mechanism to capture the complex semantic interaction between text pairs, as well as increasing the interpretability of AutoJudge.
